description: Scout connector telemetry, session-token accounting, the restrict_tools MCP gate and the two privacy gates. Activate only inside scout runs: SCOUT_MODE from the runner, or, for a session started inside a vault without a runner, the run mode its prompt names (scout/hooks/run_context.py). Interactive sessions are skipped by those. The PreToolUse restrict_tools gate is different: it applies to every session (run or interactive) in a vault whose connectors.custom.yaml uses restrict_tools, the vault being SCOUT_DATA_DIR, else the one containing the working directory; elsewhere it exits before starting Python. The privacy gates (#453) count a session as a scheduled run by #517's rule (SCOUT_MODE set, or SCOUT_READER set to anything but exactly owner). kb-read-gate denies a run's shell/Grep/Glob read of knowledge-base/ and action-items/context/ in favour of scoutctl kb (Read stays allowed; only an agent:* reader is denied it); it exits in the shell for every other session, and for a run's Bash call that names no KB path. kb-read-label (PostToolUse on Read) attaches the note's privacy label (private: never to a shared surface) in any vault session; it exits in the shell unless the payload names a KB path, and labels a note it can't classify as private. outbound-gate runs check-outbound on an MCP write tool's input in a vault (Slack as surface slack, others as connector_write): a run is denied, the owner is warned; a session in no vault that isn't a run exits in the shell. Both fail closed for runs (exit 2 when scoutctl can't run). Per #72, per-tool-call accounting was moved out of PostToolUse (which fired one Python cold-start per tool call) into the session-tool-log Stop hook that walks the transcript once at session end.

hooks.command: d="$SCOUT_DATA_DIR"; if [ -z "$d" ]; then d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/scout-config.yaml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; fi; grep -qs restrict_tools "$d/connectors.custom.yaml" || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook mcp-tool-gate

run=; { [ -n "$SCOUT_MODE" ] || { [ -n "${SCOUT_READER+set}" ] && [ "$SCOUT_READER" != owner ]; }; } && run=1; d="$SCOUT_DATA_DIR"; if [ -z "$d" ]; then d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/scout-config.yaml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; fi; [ -n "$run" ] || [ -f "$d/scout-config.yaml" ] || exit 0; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook outbound-gate && exit 0; if [ -n "$run" ]; then echo "[scout:outbound-gate] Scout's outbound privacy check could not run, so this call is blocked in a scheduled run. Put the content in the daily file or the owner's Telegram chat instead, and say so in the run notes." >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "[scout:outbound-gate] Warning: Scout's outbound privacy check could not run; this call was not checked for private content." >&2; exit 1

[ -n "$SCOUT_MODE" ] || { [ -n "${SCOUT_READER+set}" ] && [ "$SCOUT_READER" != owner ]; } || exit 0; p=$(cat); case "$p" in *'"Grep"'*|*'"Glob"'*|*knowledge-base*|*knowledge_base*|*action-items/context*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$p" | "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook kb-read-gate && exit 0; echo "[scout:kb-read-gate] Scout's KB read gate could not run, so this call is blocked in a scheduled run. Read the KB through scripts/scoutctl kb (search, files, read, resolve)." >&2; exit 2

[ -n "${SCOUT_READER+set}" ] && [ "$SCOUT_READER" != owner ] && [ "$SCOUT_READER" != autonomous ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); case "$p" in *knowledge-base*|*knowledge_base*|*action-items/context*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; printf '%s' "$p" | "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook kb-read-gate && exit 0; echo "[scout:kb-read-gate] Scout's KB read gate could not run, so this Read is blocked for this reader." >&2; exit 2

p=$(cat); case "$p" in *knowledge-base*|*knowledge_base*|*action-items/context*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; run=; { [ -n "$SCOUT_MODE" ] || { [ -n "${SCOUT_READER+set}" ] && [ "$SCOUT_READER" != owner ]; }; } && run=1; d="$SCOUT_DATA_DIR"; if [ -z "$d" ]; then d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/scout-config.yaml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; fi; [ -n "$run" ] || [ -f "$d/scout-config.yaml" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$p" | "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/engine/bin/scoutctl" hook kb-read-label && exit 0; printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "[scout:kb-label] Scout could not label the file just read, so treat it as [private]: its content must not reach any shared surface (Slack, a connector write or query, a web query, drafts/, a back-port)."}}'
